true_answer: e laer, literally 'the right or opportune moment', relates speciﬁcally to metaphysical or Divine time. In theology, Kairos is qualitative, as opposed to quantitative.[58] In Greek mythology, Chronos (ancient Greek: Χρόνος) is identiﬁed as the personiﬁcation of time. His name in Greek means 'time' and is alternatively spelled Chronus (Latin spelling) or Khronos. Chronos is usually portrayed as an old, wise man with a long, gray beard, such as 'Father Time'.
